question: Which other classes of beings are included alongside the deities in this vision?
premises: Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are named.
They form part of the same enumerated vision.
inference: The vision encompasses Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
